newsitem.title: USA: Kodak unveils digital cameras, scanner.
newsitem.headline: Kodak unveils digital cameras, scanner.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co on Monday introduced several new products, including two new digital cameras that are available now and and a color scanner that will be available May 15.
Kodak unveiled its Digital Science DC120 Zoom Digital Camera, a point-and-shoot camera that captures high-quality images and priced less than $1,000 in the United States.

It also introduced its Digital Science DVC 300 Digital Video Camera, which captures still pictures or motion video and provides live videoconferencing. It is priced at about $199 in the United States.

The Kodak Digital Science PhotoDoc Color Scanner automatically feeds pictures and documents to be scanned and handles all photo sizes. The scanner will be available May 15 at a price of $249 in the United States.
